mnemonic: 💡 看圖表線條往上還是往下發展的【趨勢】！

exampleSentence: Engineers tune RF power parameters to optimize etch rate.
exampleMeaning: 工程師微調射頻微波功率參數以達到最佳蝕刻速率。
mnemonic: 💡 細部旋鈕微調校正【調整】！

exampleSentence: Maintain uniform spindle turn rate to ensure coating thickness.
exampleMeaning: 維持恆定均勻的旋塗轉速以保證光阻膜厚高度一致。
mnemonic: 💡 晶圓在無塵室流轉的速度叫【週轉率】！

exampleSentence: Unload the finished cassette and transfer it to the cart.
exampleMeaning: 將已完成之晶圓盒自裝載口小心卸下，並平穩放置於專用推車上。
mnemonic: 💡 做完後機器把晶圓吐出來叫【下貨／卸載】！

exampleSentence: Use equipment strictly in accordance with certified training.
exampleMeaning: 僅可在自身具備合格考核認證的授權機台範圍內進行操作。
mnemonic: 💡 依照規定【使用】防靜電手套！

exampleSentence: Enter your employee username to sign into the workstation.
exampleMeaning: 在工作站畫面鍵入個人員工帳號以完成身分驗證登入。
mnemonic: 💡 電腦登入框輸入工號【使用者名稱】！

exampleSentence: Escort the equipment vendor inside the clean room.

exampleSentence: View the summary screen to verify recipe completion.
exampleMeaning: 檢視機台總結畫面以確認所有配方步驟均已順利完工。
mnemonic: 💡 記住這個單字：查看

exampleSentence: Handle each twelve-inch silicon wafer with maximum care.
exampleMeaning: 搬運與處理每一片十二吋矽晶圓時均須抱持最高等級謹慎。
mnemonic: 💡 像【威化餅乾】一樣又薄又脆的矽【晶圓】！

exampleSentence: The green light blinks indicating the tool is waiting for lot.
exampleMeaning: 綠色燈號規律閃爍表示機台目前正處於備便等料狀態。
mnemonic: 💡 貨還沒來，機台在螢幕上顯示【等待中】！

exampleSentence: A loud warning buzzer sounded when the interlock tripped.
exampleMeaning: 當安全防護互鎖開關跳脫時，現場隨即響起高分貝蜂鳴警報。
mnemonic: 💡 螢幕跳黃燈，發出嚴厲【警告】！

exampleSentence: Complete the weekly PM checklist before Friday afternoon.
exampleMeaning: 請務必於每週五下午前確實逐項填妥週保養點檢核對表。
mnemonic: 💡 每個禮拜開一次的【每週地】例會！

exampleSentence: Wear a full acid apron and face shield at the wet bench.
exampleMeaning: 於濕式化學清洗酸槽站作業時，務必著全套防酸圍裙與面罩。
mnemonic: 💡 沾到化學液體，手套摸起來【濕的】！

exampleSentence: Look through the chamber viewing window to check plasma glow.
exampleMeaning: 透過真空腔體石英觀景視窗觀察電漿電弧輝光是否均勻。
mnemonic: 💡 機台上透明可看到內部的觀察【視窗】！

exampleSentence: Excellence in particle control directly boosts overall die yield.
exampleMeaning: 落實無塵室落塵微粒嚴密控管，能直接顯著提升晶圓良率。
mnemonic: 💡 【一打】晶圓切出來好幾千顆，最看重的就是【良率】！

exampleSentence: Our team strives every single shift for zero defect quality.
exampleMeaning: 全體輪班同仁在每一班別均齊心協力追求零缺陷之極致品質。
mnemonic: 💡 追求工安意外掛【零】！
